text:
emily_cs: Quick capture from today's onboarding calls — heard the same asks from 3 customers in a row. Can we centralize?

jacob_pm: Yep, what were the asks?

emily_cs: Top items: per-route cost breakdown (not just per-account), CSV/BI export of route+flag history, and an in-console cost-estimate popover during routing setup. Also a small DM about wanting a 'what changed' diff for rollout flag versions.

mira_se: Per-route cost breakdown is doable on our side but we'll need the attribution signal from the router — currently we aggregate at model+account.

sam_prod: +1 on the CSV export. Customers want weekly dumps to feed into their finance dashboards. Minimal schema: account, route, date, tokens, cost_usd, flag_version, model_id.

natalie_csm: A couple customers are worried about renewal risk if they can't justify cost per feature. They see overall spend but not per-product line. This becomes a negotiation blocker.

jacob_pm: Sounds like a mix of product (visibility) and infra (emit metrics). Priorities? We should split immediate antipains vs. longer dev work.

emily_cs: Immediate win = CSV export + short-term UI: add a 'Download usage report' button on onboarding > routes. Medium = per-route breakdown in Console. Long = rollout diff/flag history viewer.

mira_se: For CSV we can add an API endpoint that streams a report. ETA ~2w if scoped small (last 90 days, per-route). Need a JIRA and a sample spec.

sam_prod: I'll draft the spec. Quick ask: include a sample header so CS can validate with customers. e.g.,

```
account_id,route_name,route_id,date,model_id,tokens_in,tokens_out,total_tokens,cost_usd,flag_version
```

emily_cs: Perfect — CS will validate. Also ask PMs: can we surface cost-estimate when creating a new route? Customers asked for a small tooltip like: "Expected cost per 1k tokens: $0.12 (based on model + batching)"

jacob_pm: That's a great UX compromise. We'll need a small pricing model proxy from Optimize to estimate. @mira_se can we stub this with static per-model rates first?

mira_se: Yes, stubbing is fast. We'll expose endpoint /internal/cost-estimate that accepts model_id + avg_seq and returns usd_per_1k.

natalie_csm: For prioritization matrix, CS recommends: CSV export (high impact, low effort), cost-estimate tooltip (medium effort, high impact for onboarding), per-route analytics (high effort, high impact), rollout diff viewer (medium effort, medium impact).

emily_cs: Thanks all. Action items: @sam_prod draft spec and attach sample CSV; @mira_se create JIRA for CSV export + internal cost-estimate stub; @jacob_pm capture prioritization in roadmap. I'll follow up with customers and confirm acceptance criteria.

feedback-bot: New ticket created: #CS-4278 "Route usage CSV export" by mira_se

jacob_pm: Thanks — ping when JIRA IDs are up and I'll slot it into next planning. :thumbsup:

mira_se: will do.

emily_cs: Closing the loop: customers interested are AcmeRetail, HelixCardio, and ParkCo. I'll attach their examples to the ticket once Sam shares spec.

natalie_csm: +1 on attaching examples — helps land scope.

sam_prod: Draft done, uploading to the ticket now.

emily_cs: Awesome. That should reduce renewal uncertainty for those accounts.
